articles.title: India orders audit of electronic waste recyclers to catch fake compliance
articles.description: India has ordered audits of more than 2,000 waste recyclers, including 309 electronic waste processing units, amid concerns over inflated recycling claims and forged compliance documents. The inspections will cover machinery, plant operations, electricity consumption and production records. The move is aimed at tightening oversight of the e-waste sector and ensuring companies such as Apple, Samsung and LG meet recycling obligations.
